description: MainActivity.java is an Android Java source file defining the MainActivity class for a Bluetooth chat application. It manages the main UI, including fragment transactions, menu options, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is an Android activity that serves as the launcher for the Bluetooth chat app. It sets up the UI, manages a logging fragment, and provides menu options to toggle log visibility.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the BluetoothChatFragment when first created.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from the main menu resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu before display, toggling log menu visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically toggling the log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain with custom log wrapper and filter, and associates it with the LogFragment.
